attributes.name: bg-color
attributes.description: Brand palette for the shape background at level 100; an explicit empty value leaves it transparent.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Brand palette, with varied levels for individual words.

attributes.name: rotate
attributes.description: Maximum word rotation in degrees, clamped to -90–90; orientations alternate between zero and both signs.

attributes.name: scale
attributes.description: Positive font-size multiplier, clamped to 0.1–4; crowded clouds shrink together to fit.

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: Outer silhouette, using English names only.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-word-cloud>` element generates a responsive SVG word cloud inside a chosen silhouette.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Word cloud | No component-specific mouse interaction. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Word cloud | No component-specific keyboard interaction. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User help for the component under the pointer, falling back to the focused component. <kbd>Shift</kbd> may be needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose which component in the enclosing hierarchy should receive contextual help. |
